top.line: How a large agent team is started, stopped, slowed and moved between accounts, from eighteen days of data.

in-short.line: The brake as much as the engine; 8,027 commits; 560 to 76 wakes; 39 schedules; limits; the account move.

run-and-stop.line: Control means stopping, braking, slowing and speeding up; the analysis is maestro.b's.

timeline.line: Running hot, the big stop and restart, the hand brake, the account move, twice a day, slow until Monday.

mechanisms.line: Schedules as throttle, my word written first, HOLD.md, one conductor on, budgets measure, context, policies.

spend.line: About 90 dollars an hour fell to about 18, then 10.7; commits followed wakes.

constraint.line: The seven-day limit warned three times; it forces the question of what matters.

accounts.line: 34 agents restarted on an isolated account in four hours from their debriefs: sovereignty and resilience.

limits.line: API-equivalent dollars; account A's ledger missing; some early counts estimated.

sources.line: maestro.b's analysis in the PrompTugal repository, read on 21 November 2026.
